title: ncdu misses Chinese characters and formats incorrectly

milestone.title: Known Problem
milestone.description: This milestone contains issues which are known problems which are proving difficult to fix, or are awaiting an external fix or we haven't got round to yet.

body:
#### What is the problem you are having with rclone?
`ncdu` doesn't format Chinese characters correctly.
Specifically, it misses one character every two characters on all systems tested.
On Windows it also has formatting issues

Example 1:
```
$ rclone lsf gdrive:test
一二三四五六

$ rclone ncdu gdrive:test

rclone ncdu v1.46 - use the arrow keys to navigate, press ? for help               
-- gdrive:test --------------------------------------------------------------------
       0 [          ]  一三五                                                      
```

Example 2 (formatting issue on Windows)
![screenshot 2019-02-20 152215](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/8552945/53122074-aaf7ba00-3523-11e9-9956-7772fe0ff246.png)


#### What is your rclone version (output from `rclone version`)
1. daily use
```
rclone v1.46
- os/arch: windows/amd64
- go version: go1.11
```
2. test VM
```
rclone v1.46.0-027-g8f4ea77c-beta
- os/arch: linux/386
- go version: go1.12rc1
```

#### Which OS you are using and how many bits (eg Windows 7, 64 bit)
1. daily use: Windows 7, 64-bit
2. test VM: Lubuntu on VirtualBox
```
$ uname -a
Linux xa2gq-VirtualBox 4.15.0-45-generic #48-Ubuntu SMP Tue Jan 29 16:27:25 UTC 2019 i686 i686 i686 GNU/Linux

$ cat /etc/os-release 
NAME="Ubuntu"
VERSION="18.04.1 LTS (Bionic Beaver)"
ID=ubuntu
ID_LIKE=debian
PRETTY_NAME="Ubuntu 18.04.1 LTS"
VERSION_ID="18.04"
HOME_URL="https://www.ubuntu.com/"
SUPPORT_URL="https://help.ubuntu.com/"
BUG_REPORT_URL="https://bugs.launchpad.net/ubuntu/"
PRIVACY_POLICY_URL="https://www.ubuntu.com/legal/terms-and-policies/privacy-policy"
VERSION_CODENAME=bionic
UBUNTU_CODENAME=bionic
```

####  Which cloud storage system are you using? (eg Google Drive)
Google Drive

#### The command you were trying to run (eg `rclone copy /tmp remote:tmp`)
`rclone ncdu`

#### A log from the command with the `-vv` flag (eg output from `rclone -vv copy /tmp remote:tmp`)
```
xa2gq@xa2gq-VirtualBox:~$ rclone ncdu -vv gdrive:test
```
